issues.what: The flash obscures the miniature but leaves the collar and tabletop readable. The tan shell collar visibly snaps to a dark twig collar, and the sand pile is replaced by scattered orange leaves in the same beat.
issues.fix: Carry a single collar silhouette, contact shadow, and reflection through the change, or fully occlude the whole base during the swap. Animate the sand displacement and leaf scatter from the landing so the tabletop does not reset with the collar.

issues.where: summer canopy and cottage lights after landing, especially compared with set-D-08.jpg
issues.what: The canopy, roof, and lanterns already have their final shapes at the start of the arrival. The later frames mainly lower the haze and bloom over them, so summer is uncovered rather than growing in.
issues.fix: Keep the cottage and trunk anchored, but stagger the leaf unfurling, ground-cover growth, and lantern light-up as the last vortices settle.
